name: Lucemon: Chaos Mode
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, your opponent may delete 1 of their Digimon or Tamers. If this effect didn't delete, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, your opponent may delete 1 of their Digimon or Tamers. If this effect didn't delete, it doesn't leave.
